subject: Replatform due diligence: throughput delta & renewal plan — Ferrum AI
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@ferrum.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@ferrum.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Replatform due diligence + renewal window

Hi Avery —

As we discussed on the call last week, our renewal is in Q3 and leadership has asked the platform team to run a short replatform due-diligence sprint before we commit. Aster Labs has submitted an RFP and is offering a discounted migration plan — our execs want concrete throughput/cost delta numbers to compare.

Can Redwood run a quick throughput comparison for our core text-generation workload (avg seq len ~128, 12k reqs/min peak) and share an apples-to-apples latency + cost delta? Carlos is attaching the preliminary workload traces.

High level asks:
- 95p latency at 128 tokens, steady-state and 30% burst
- Token-level cost estimate for 6 months at current volume + 2x growth scenario
- Any migration blockers (data residency / KV cache preservation / model-compat)

We'd like a short technical readout for our CTO and a commercial save option if numbers are competitive. Can you confirm timeline?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Engineering
Ferrum AI

[Attachment: ferrum_initial_bench.csv (csv)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@ferrum.ai>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@ferrum.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Replatform due diligence + renewal window

Elena — thanks for the clear asks and the traces. We can run an apples-to-apples comparison and deliver a short readout + cost delta within 3 business days. Quick notes:

- We'll reproduce the 128-token distribution and peak shaping you shared; please confirm whether the 12k/min figure is steady or an instantaneous bucketed peak.
- For cost estimates we will assume current model version (gpt-family-3.2q) and a quantized 8-bit serving path unless you ask us to keep 16-bit.
- Migration blockers: we need to confirm KMS access for key rotation details if you plan to bring keys, and whether you require request-level audit logs to stay in your VPC.

I'll run this engagement personally — looping in Karthik (solutions) and Michael (post-sales) for throughput testing and ops requirements.

Proposed next steps:
1) Carlos confirms whether the 12k/min is sustained or burst
2) We run bench (3 business days)
3) Readout + suggested renewal term options (cost + throughput tradeoffs)

If that timeline works I'll schedule the bench run first thing Monday and send the invite.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@ferrum.ai>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@ferrum.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: ferrum traces + architecture notes — urgent bench & risk plan

Team —

Ferrum (external) is running a vendor bakeoff; renewal in Q3. They need a throughput + cost delta by EOD Thursday. Key constraints: 12k reqs/min peak (10–15m sustained), 128-token avg, and a KV-cache hot-path that must be preserved on migration.

Can we do a parallel bench:
- baseline: their traces (as-is) on our standard gpt-family-3.2q 8-bit profile
- fallback: model variant gpt-family-3.2q-memopt if we need lower latency at similar cost
- measure: 95p latency, p99, tokens/sec, and effective cost per 1M tokens (assuming 6 months committed)

Specific asks:
- Karthik: can you own kernel selection/latency tuning and validate memopt variant viability by EOD Wednesday?
- Michael: can you confirm operational migration blockers (KMS flow, audit logs, KV cache snapshot/restore) and what we need from Ferrum to demo a non-disruptive cutover?
- Marissa: I'll need a short executive-facing save proposal (two tiered offers: standard renewal + accelerated capacity discount) — draft by Thursday morning so we can include in readout.

I'll run the bench on Wednesday morning 02:00–06:00 PT (we can replay traces against a reserved cluster). Elena/Carlos — we will share raw bench CSV and a short slide deck after the run.

Thanks everyone — this is a time-boxed save play.

Avery

---

Avery / team —

Appreciate the fast turn. The Thursday slot works for us for a readout. Two quick asks ahead of the bench:
1) please include a short comparison vs. the Aster Labs baseline (they've provided single-run numbers but not traces) — a conservative delta is fine.
2) if your memopt variant shows <10% p95 improvement at same cost, can you include an option for a 6-month trial with a 20% capped uplift on committed spend? That's the commercial angle execs asked for.

We'll be on the call for the readout and want a slide deck summarizing latency/cost and a migration checklist (KMS + audit + KV). If the numbers look competitive we'll request a short-term contract extension tied to the trial.

Thanks — Elena

Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Engineering, Ferrum AI
